title: Library
note: Pure Go: puzzle (argon2id-over-hashcash challenge/solve/verify) and credit (signing/verification) packages, table-driven tests, a difficulty benchmark. No network code.

title: Mint, work leg only
note: Single binary. POST /mint/work. In-process per-key counters, SQLite for durability. No payment leg yet.

title: Gate
note: Caddy forward_auth endpoint borrowed from auth-gate. Token bucket per IP/ASN, 402 emission, credit verification, use burning.

title: Client
note: WASM solver plus HTML interstitial, and a Go client library for non-browser agents.

title: Deploy on pynezz.dev
note: Instrument solve times, credits minted, bucket hit rate, and work-path traffic share.

title: Paid leg
note: Cashu mint for bearer credits, priced against observed work cost. x402 compatibility.
